[မုဟ+ယ+မာန]

muyhati.cp: muh + ya. forgets; becomes dull; infatuates.
muyhati.p: [Muha+ya+ti] (kri) CL=7 [Nīti,dhā.240.] He is being unconscious.

B:
muyhati： muyhati（kri）
မုယှတိ（ကြိ）
[muha+ya+ti．nīti，dhā．24va．]
[မုဟ+ယ+တိ။ နီတိ၊ဓာ။၂၄ဝ။]
C: muyhati：[muh + ya] forgets； becomes dull； infatuates．
P: Muyhati，[Vedic muhyati，muh； defn Dhtp 343：mucchāyaṁ； 460：vecitte； cp．moha & momuha] to get bewildered，to be infatuated，to become dull in one’s senses，to be stupified．Just as rāga，dosa & moha form a set，so do the verbs rajjati，dussati，muyhati，e．g．Miln．386 （rajjasi rajjanīyesu，dussanīyesu dussasi，muyhase mohaniyesu）．Otherwise rare as finite verb； only DhsA．254 （in defn of moha） & Sdhp．282，605 （so read for mayhate）．-- pp．mūḷha & muddha1．（Page 539）
I: muyhati：To be faint； to be perplexed，bewildered，infatuated
K:
muyhati：မုယှတိ（ကြိ）
[မုဟ+ယ+တိ။ နီတိ၊ဓာ။၂၄ဝ။]
တွေဝေ-မိန်းမော-၏။
R:
muyhati：မုယှတိ （√မုဟ်）
တွေဝေ၏။ တွေဝေမိန်းမော၏။

muyhi.cp: aor. of muyhati. forgot; became dull; infatuated.
